name: Integrate Pipedrive and Gravity Forms
author: Oyova

sections.description:
Integrate Gravity Forms with Pipedrive. Connect forms on your website, collect lead data into your CRM & power up your email & marketing automation.

Intelligent Integration

Connect your forms with Pipedrive and push your lead data into your CRM. Capture new leads from any form on your site.

External services

This plugin connects to the Pipedrive API to send form data into the CRM. The data sent to Pipedrive is the data you specify in the Gravity Forms feed.

This API service is provied by “Pipedrive”: terms of service, privacy policy.
